area: Your app: its install, its user and its doors
description: One till key answered by a partner's own HTTPS service. Only a System Manager keeps these records; a store switches the key on in POS Studio.

fields.description: Partner whose service answers this key. Shown by the app name in POS Studio's Apps tab.
fields.label: Partner

fields.description: 1 to 80 of a-z, 0-9 and _. Cannot be changed later or match an installed app's name.
fields.label: App name

fields.description: 1 to 40 of: a-z, 0-9, underscore. One partner can have several keys.
fields.label: Key

fields.description: Tick it to let the key reach tills; untick it to stop it on every till. A store switches it on for its theme in POS Studio, on the Apps tab.
fields.label: Enabled
May return a message for the cashier
May return line details (Transaction Item Attributes)

fields.description: The partner's HTTPS address. One signed request per press, and redirects are not followed.
fields.label: Address

fields.description: Shared with the partner to sign each request. Never shown on the till or in an error log.
fields.label: Signing secret

fields.description: How long the till waits for an answer. 3 seconds unless you raise it; at most 10.
fields.label: Time to answer (seconds)

fields.description: What the till sends to this address at each press: sale_ref (the till's own id for the sale) · store · pos_profile · company · currency · operator (the signed-in cashier's user id, personal data) · customer (the customer's id when one is on the sale, personal data) · lines (item_code, qty, uom and the line's own id for each item). No price, total, payment, serial or batch is sent.
fields.label: The shop agrees to send these sale details to this address

fields.description: Who agreed to send these details: the user who ticked the consent box, or who consented to the app's install. Stamped by the server.
fields.label: Recorded by

lede: A key on the till that calls your service. A manifest installs it.
name: Retail Remote App Key
why: contract remote_till_key; guide chapter 06; guide chapter 13; recipe ai_till_key; recipe point_handler
